description: Corrected comparison of CG33090-PC and human GBA2 isoform lesions with verified active-site residue positions
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12.5,4.8))
rows=[
 ("human GBA2 isoform 1 (927 aa)",       [],                 "active (4MUG, COS-7)"),
 ("human GBA2 X1/X2/X4 (+6 aa insertion)",[("ins",189,196)],  "background activity"),
 ("human GBA2 X7/X8 (p.F190_Q268del)",   [("del",190,268)],  "background activity"),
 ("human GBA2 UniProt isoform 3 (640 aa)",[("del",1,287)],    "never assayed"),
 ("fly CG33090-PB (948 aa, GBA2 ortholog)",[],                "never assayed"),
 ("fly CG33090-PC (799 aa)",             [("del",1,207),("alt",207,235)], "never assayed"),
]
for k,(lab,les,note) in enumerate(rows):
    y=len(rows)-k
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1,y-0.22),927,0.44,color="#cfd8dc",ec="k",lw=0.6))
    for kind,a,b in les:
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((a,y-0.22),b-a,0.44,color={"del":"#c0392b","ins":"#8e44ad","alt":"#2980b9"}[kind]))
    ax.text(-15,y,lab,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=9)
    ax.text(945,y,note,ha="left",va="center",fontsize=8.5,
            color="#1e7a3c" if note.startswith("active") else ("#c0392b" if "background" in note else "#7f8c8d"))
for pos,lab in [(527,"E527"),(538,"D538"),(593,"H593"),(677,"D677"),(864,"E864"),(873,"R873")]:
    ax.plot([pos],[0.40],marker="^",color="k",ms=7); ax.text(pos,0.02,lab,ha="center",fontsize=7.5)
ax.text(700,-0.30,"GH116 active-site residues of human GBA2 (all retained in fly PC as E362, D373, H428, D575, E765, R774)",
        ha="center",fontsize=8.5)
ax.axvspan(1,207,color="#c0392b",alpha=0.07)
ax.set_xlim(-360,1290); ax.set_ylim(-0.55,len(rows)+0.8); ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xticks([1,200,400,600,800,927])
ax.set_xlabel("position in human GBA2 isoform 1 coordinates (fly isoforms mapped by pairwise alignment)")
ax.set_title("GH116 N-terminal lesions in common coordinates: red deleted, purple inserted, blue isoform-specific new N terminus",fontsize=10.5)
for s in ("top","right","left"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.show()
